threat_event: Ransomware encrypts HQ servers, the plant server, endpoints, and cloud workloads across all subsidiaries after the attacker takes over the directory
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Over-privileged directory (14 Domain Admins members); HQ backups on a NAS in the same server room; flat plant network; directory forest recovery never tested; Home Services North unmanaged
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; SYS-04; SYS-08; SYS-10; SYS-15; BP-01 to BP-16
sp800_53_controls: CP-9; CP-10; CP-4; AC-6; SC-7; SI-4
regulatory_driver: 16 CFR 314.4(h) (Finance); N55-R06 (164.308(a)(7)); CSF 2.0 group profile RC.RP-01
existing_controls: EDR on managed endpoints and servers with 24x7 MSSP; MFA on SaaS; immutable cloud backups in a separate account; suite backup
treatment_plan: Directory tiering and privileged access management; off-site immutable backups for HQ and plant servers; directory forest recovery test; plant segmentation; integrate Home Services North; group ransomware tabletop 2026-11-18
exposure_estimate_usd: $3M-$8M (72-hour group outage about $550,000 unrecovered revenue and labor; response, notification, legal; insurance limit $10M)

threat_event: Exfiltration of Finance customer information, plan PHI, and employee SSNs from file servers, collaboration sites, and the reporting warehouse before encryption (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: File servers, warehouse queries, and subsidiary SaaS do not log to the SIEM; no egress anomaly alerting; HR site with plan PHI open to 11 HR staff
existing_controls: EDR; SIEM on identity, suite, firewall, directory, and cloud logs; MFA
treatment_plan: Forward warehouse, file server, and SaaS audit logs; egress alerting on the cloud firewall and site firewalls; restrict the HR site to the Benefits team; data map
exposure_estimate_usd: $2M-$6M (up to 34,000 consumers, 600 employees, and 1,100 plan members notified; counsel, forensics, credit monitoring)

threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing steals the session of an administrator or a treasury, payables, HR, or Finance user
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA is not phishing-resistant; conditional access requires a compliant device only for administrators
regulatory_driver: 16 CFR 314.4(c)(5) (Finance); N55-R06 (164.312(d)); CSF 2.0 group profile PR.AA-03
existing_controls: Number matching; impossible-travel detection by the MSSP; quarterly phishing simulations
treatment_plan: FIDO2 keys for about 70 high-risk users; compliant-device conditional access for all users; token-theft detection rules
exposure_estimate_usd: $250,000-$1.5M (account takeover leading to fraud or data exposure)

threat_event: Attacker abuses one of 14 Domain Admins members or 23 non-expiring service accounts; synchronization carries the compromise to the cloud identity provider and every SaaS system
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No directory tiering; service accounts in Domain Admins; no MFA for directory administration; privileged access management covers only cloud consoles
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; SYS-10; all SaaS through single sign-on
regulatory_driver: 16 CFR 314.4(c)(1) (Finance); N55-R06 (164.308(a)(4)); CSF 2.0 group profile PR.AA-05
existing_controls: EDR on domain controllers; directory logs in the SIEM
treatment_plan: Tier 0 model; remove service accounts from Domain Admins; managed service accounts and vaulted secrets; MFA for directory administration through the broker; quarterly privileged review

threat_event: Business email compromise: a fake supplier or a compromised supplier mailbox requests a bank-detail change, and a payment is redirected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Callback procedure not always documented (P07: 2 of 25 sampled bank changes); Home Services North pays some vendors locally outside the ERP
existing_controls: Callback rule in shared payables since 2025; dual approval; positive pay; payment fraud training for treasury and payables
treatment_plan: Callback evidence required in the ERP before release; 5-day hold on first payment to changed details; North vendor payments moved into the ERP; payment fraud runbook (P08)
exposure_estimate_usd: $100,000-$1M per event (crime policy social engineering sublimit $250,000)

threat_event: Stolen treasury user credentials or session used to release a fraudulent wire
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Treasury users on push MFA; bank hardware tokens and dual approval limit the harm
existing_controls: Bank-enforced dual approval and hardware tokens; payee callback; positive pay
treatment_plan: FIDO2 keys for treasury users; bank alerts on new payees to the Treasurer's phone

threat_event: An attacker enters the group through Home Services North: an unmanaged laptop, the seller's IT provider's administrator access, or the separate email tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 38 laptops without group EDR or device management; separate tenant without group MFA policy; seller's IT provider holds server administrator rights; no day-1 integration standard
existing_controls: Separate firewall replaced on day 1; HRIS and ERP accounts with group MFA
treatment_plan: Day-1 controls now: EDR on all North laptops, end the seller's access, MFA on the North tenant; full integration into group identity, email, and field-service system by 2027-03-31

threat_event: A former or transferred employee uses access that was not removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Subsidiary terminations reach shared IT about 2 business days late; transfers keep prior access; no access reviews outside the ERP
existing_controls: HRIS-driven disablement for integrated users; ERP review twice a year
treatment_plan: Same-day termination from HRIS for all entities; automated removal of prior roles on transfer; quarterly reviews for Tier 1 systems

threat_event: Plan PHI (appeals, stop-loss files, high-cost claimant reports) is viewed by HR staff without a plan-administration role or used in an employment decision
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HR collaboration site open to 11 HR staff; plan documents lack 164.314(b) terms; no access logging review
existing_controls: HIPAA training for the Benefits team; plan document 164.504(f) terms
treatment_plan: Move plan PHI to a restricted benefits site for 2 named staff; amend plan documents for 164.314(b); quarterly access log review by the plan Privacy Official

threat_event: Breach of plan PHI for up to 1,100 covered persons through compromise of the HR site or a benefits mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA; benefits mailbox receives TPA reports by email; no plan breach procedure before 2026-09
existing_controls: MFA; EDR; TPA reports sent by secure email
treatment_plan: TPA reports through the TPA portal only; restricted benefits site; plan breach procedure in P08; FIDO2 keys for the Benefits team

threat_event: Bulk export of Finance customer information from the loan servicing system through a compromised Finance user session or an insider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Servicing system audit logs not in the SIEM; 19 Finance users hold export rights; no export alerting
existing_controls: SSO with MFA; vendor SOC 2 controls
treatment_plan: Forward servicing audit logs; alert on exports over 500 records; limit export rights to 4 named roles

threat_event: ACH collection files holding consumer bank account numbers are stolen from the SFTP server
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Files kept indefinitely; server reachable only from the banks; EDR installed
existing_controls: Inbound only from bank addresses; key authentication; EDR
treatment_plan: Delete files after 90 days; encrypt the file store with company keys

threat_event: A known vulnerability is exploited on a branch, shop, or plant device that is never scanned, or on a server patched late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scanning covers only HQ and the cloud; 18% of critical findings missed the 30-day target in 2026 H1
existing_controls: Quarterly scans of HQ and cloud; automatic endpoint patching
treatment_plan: Monthly authenticated scans at all 9 sites; passive discovery on the plant network; patch targets in STD-09 tracked monthly

threat_event: A zero-day in an internet-facing firewall or VPN appliance is exploited before a patch is applied
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 site firewalls and the VPN service are internet-facing; emergency patch process informal
existing_controls: Weekly known exploited vulnerabilities review; MSSP alerting
treatment_plan: Emergency patch procedure with a 72-hour target for known exploited edge flaws; remove management interfaces from the internet

threat_event: A machine vendor's always-on remote access tool is compromised, and the attacker reaches the plant floor and office networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Always-on tool with shared credentials; flat plant network; no session logging
existing_controls: Plant firewall at the internet edge
treatment_plan: Remove the always-on tool; vendor sessions through the privileged access broker on request with recording; separate plant floor and office networks

threat_event: The plant server is lost to ransomware, hardware failure, or fire, and up to a week of nesting programs is lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Weekly removable-drive backup kept in the plant office; never restore-tested; RPO 24 h not achievable
existing_controls: Repeat programs stored on machine controllers
treatment_plan: Nightly backup of the plant server to the cloud backup account; quarterly restore test

threat_event: An unsupported embedded Windows version on 2 machine controllers is exploited or fails without vendor support
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor supports the controllers only on that version; no compensating controls
existing_controls: Machines are not used for email or browsing
treatment_plan: Isolate the 2 controllers in their own segment with allow-listed flows; replacement in the 2027 capital plan

threat_event: An intrusion goes undetected in systems that do not send logs to the SIEM (file servers, ERP, HRIS, subsidiary SaaS, plant, Home Services North)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Logging gaps (gap 8)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-05; SYS-10; SYS-12 to SYS-15
existing_controls: 24x7 MSSP on core sources
treatment_plan: Onboard the missing sources in priority order (servicing system, ERP, HRIS, file servers, plant firewall)

threat_event: The distribution system vendor has an outage longer than BP-09 and BP-10 can tolerate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor contract RTO 24 h against a BIA RTO of 4 h (BP-09) and 8 h (BP-10)
existing_controls: Paper tickets and printed price lists
treatment_plan: Negotiate recovery terms at renewal (2027-03); daily order export to the HQ file share; downtime drill at Branch 1

threat_event: A critical SaaS vendor (ERP, servicing, HRIS, treasury) is breached, and the group relied on controls it never checked
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SOC 2 reports reviewed for only 8 of 22 critical vendors; complementary user entity controls not mapped for the rest
existing_controls: Contracts with security terms for new vendors since 2025
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 review for all 22 critical vendors (P09); CUEC mapping; breach notice terms at renewal

threat_event: The MSSP or its platform is compromised and its EDR response rights are used against every endpoint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSSP can isolate and run scripts on all endpoints; review of its SOC 2 found the SIEM platform carved out
existing_controls: MSSP SOC 2 Type 2 (Security); contract security terms
treatment_plan: Obtain the platform provider's SOC 2; restrict MSSP script execution to approved runbooks; alert on mass actions

threat_event: An attacker takes over an employee's HRIS account and redirects the employee's direct deposit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Self-service bank changes allowed with MFA
existing_controls: MFA; email notice of bank changes
treatment_plan: Hold first payroll to changed accounts for verification; alert payroll on changes within 5 days of payday

threat_event: The generative AI assistant returns Restricted data from another company (Finance customer information, plan PHI, deal information) to a user without a need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 96 collaboration sites never reviewed; no data-access review before the 180-user rollout
regulatory_driver: 16 CFR 314.4(c)(1)(ii) (Finance); N55-R06 (164.308(a)(4)); CSF 2.0 group profile GV.PO-01
existing_controls: Assistant respects existing permissions; no connectors or agents
treatment_plan: Site permission clean-up; Restricted labels that block retrieval; repeat the cross-entity test (P10 AI-001 conditions)

threat_event: Finance's credit scorecard (AI-002) makes automated declines on a prohibited basis or with adverse action reasons that are not specific
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No model validation, no fair lending testing, generic vendor reason codes, automated declines without review
existing_controls: Vendor model documentation; Finance Compliance Officer reviews notice templates
treatment_plan: Replace generic reasons; validate the model and test outcomes by group; manual review of auto-declines until validated (P10 AI-002)

threat_event: The recruiting software's AI ranking screens out qualified candidates through proxies for age, disability, or national origin
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Adopted by Supply and Home Services without review; candidates below a score are never seen by a recruiter
regulatory_driver: Title VII (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2); ADEA; ADA (federal employment discrimination law)
existing_controls: Recruiters choose interviewees from the ranked list
treatment_plan: Turn off auto-rejection; recruiter review of all applicants; adverse impact analysis by HR with counsel (P10 AI-003)

threat_event: The after-hours AI voice agent mishandles an emergency call (gas smell, no cooling for a vulnerable customer) and the customer is harmed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Emergency triage script never tested before go-live; P10 test: 2 of 30 scripted emergency calls not escalated
regulatory_driver: CSF 2.0 group profile GV.SC-05; Fla. Stat. 934.03 (call recording consent)
existing_controls: Calls are recorded; on-call manager reviews the overnight log each morning
treatment_plan: Hard-coded escalation for emergency keywords; live transfer to the on-call manager; monthly test calls (P10 AI-005)

threat_event: Staff paste Restricted data into unapproved public AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public chatbots not blocked; 14 users found in web proxy logs
existing_controls: Approved enterprise assistant available
treatment_plan: Block public chatbots on managed devices; AI module in training

threat_event: A security event affecting Finance customer information is handled without a tested plan and misses the FTC 30-day notice or state notices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group plan exercised once (holding company only); subsidiaries not included
existing_controls: P08 runbooks and notification matrix (2026-09-22)
treatment_plan: Group tabletop including the FTC notice on 2026-11-18; subsidiary annexes

threat_event: A breach of plan PHI is not recognized as a HIPAA breach, and the 60-day clocks are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No plan breach procedure before 2026-09; HR staff not trained to escalate
existing_controls: TPA notifies the plan of TPA-side breaches under the BAA
treatment_plan: Plan breach procedure in P08; decision log; train the Benefits team and HR

threat_event: An add-on acquisition closes without cyber due diligence, bringing an existing compromise or unmanaged systems into the group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written due diligence or day-1 standard; 2 to 3 acquisitions a year
existing_controls: Financial and legal due diligence
treatment_plan: M&A cyber due diligence checklist; compromise assessment before connecting; day-1 control set (POL-01 4.13)

threat_event: Material non-public deal information leaks from the data room, email, or board portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Data room controlled; email forwarding of deal files not blocked
existing_controls: Data room watermarking and access logs
treatment_plan: Restricted labels for deal sites; block external forwarding of labeled files

threat_event: A hurricane closes HQ, the distribution center, and shops for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HQ servers and the plant server on-site; single ISP at the plant
existing_controls: Cloud workloads in a second region; laptops for remote work
treatment_plan: Move HQ file and scanner servers to the cloud; pre-season checklist each May; alternate dispatch from Central

threat_event: The plant's single internet circuit fails and the plant cannot reach the ERP or receive orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single ISP at the plant
existing_controls: Orders by phone
treatment_plan: Cellular failover kit at the plant

threat_event: An undocumented change to the directory, ERP configuration, firewalls, or the integration service opens unintended access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: P07: 7 of 25 sampled changes had no approval
existing_controls: Peer approval for cloud and firewall changes
treatment_plan: One change process for all Tier 1 systems with a weekly change review

threat_event: An integration service error corrupts subsidiary data feeding consolidation and lender reports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mapping changes not always ticketed; no reconciliation report
existing_controls: Month-end reconciliations by accounting
treatment_plan: Daily control totals from each subsidiary system; change approval

threat_event: A caller impersonating an employee gets the service desk to reset MFA and takes over the account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Identity checks at the service desk rely on employee number and manager name
existing_controls: Manager confirmation by email
treatment_plan: Video identity check plus callback to the manager's number on file; no MFA reset by phone for administrators

threat_event: A lost or stolen technician tablet or laptop exposes consumer names, addresses, and service history
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Devices encrypted with remote wipe
existing_controls: Encryption; remote wipe; PIN
treatment_plan: Accepted by the VP of Information Technology: encryption makes the data unreadable; reviewed yearly

threat_event: Finance keeps declined-applicant files and ACH files beyond need, which enlarges any breach and breaks the disposal rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No retention schedule; indefinite keeping (gap 13)
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Group retention schedule; purge declined-applicant files after the legal retention period; 90-day ACH file deletion
exposure_estimate_usd: Raises R-002 and R-011 notification counts

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration (public storage or an over-broad role) exposes the reporting warehouse
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails block public storage; roles reviewed only yearly
existing_controls: Organization guardrails; posture alerts
treatment_plan: Quarterly cloud role review

threat_event: An attacker deletes or encrypts the cloud backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups write-once in a separate account and region with separate credentials
existing_controls: Write-once retention; separate credentials; delete denied
treatment_plan: Accepted by the CFO: within appetite because backups are isolated and write-once; reviewed yearly

threat_event: HQ server backups on the NAS are encrypted together with production in a ransomware attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: NAS in the same server room and domain as the servers
existing_controls: Nightly backups
treatment_plan: Send HQ server backups to the cloud backup account; remove the NAS from the domain

threat_event: The bank partner delays or ends the participation program because servicing and security controls are not ready for a SOC 2 Type 2
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Readiness gaps in P09; Type 2 period cannot start before 2027-07
existing_controls: Participation agreement signed; readiness plan (P09)
treatment_plan: Remediate P09 Not ready criteria; Type 1 report by 2027-06-30; monthly status to the bank

threat_event: During an identity outage the crisis team cannot coordinate because email, chat, and phones depend on the same tenant
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No tested out-of-band channel
existing_controls: Personal mobile phones
treatment_plan: Out-of-band messaging group and printed call trees at every site; quarterly test

threat_event: Card data is compromised at Supply or Home Services through terminals or the contractor portal's payment page
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Point-to-point encrypted devices and a processor-hosted payment page
existing_controls: Point-to-point encryption; hosted payment page
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Supply President: card data never enters group systems; processor attestation reviewed yearly

threat_event: A Finance employee looks up or sells customer information without a business reason
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Servicing system activity not reviewed
existing_controls: Background checks; role-based access
treatment_plan: Monthly access analytics once servicing logs reach the SIEM

threat_event: Credential stuffing against the Supply contractor portal places orders on contractors' credit accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-managed portal accounts without MFA
existing_controls: Credit limits; delivery confirmation
treatment_plan: Turn on the vendor's MFA option for portal users

threat_event: Staff at the Branch 2 counter share 3 generic accounts, so actions cannot be traced and passwords never change (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generic accounts created for shift changes
existing_controls: Counter PCs lock after 10 minutes
treatment_plan: Named accounts with fast user switching; disable the generic accounts

threat_event: An ISP outage or denial-of-service attack cuts the distribution center off
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dual ISPs at the distribution center
existing_controls: Dual ISPs; provider DDoS protection
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Supply President: dual circuits meet the BIA; reviewed yearly

threat_event: A tampered or corrupted machine program damages equipment or injures an operator
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Programs on the plant server are not integrity-checked
existing_controls: Mechanical guarding; operator checks first piece
treatment_plan: Program check-in with hashes and a second-person review for new programs

threat_event: An insider or attacker uses the ACH signing service account, whose password is stored in an IT runbook, to alter or send ACH files (found in P07)
threat_source: Insider or attacker with IT site access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password readable by 14 IT staff; non-expiring; no integrity check on files before upload
existing_controls: Bank positive pay and file totals call-back for files over $500,000
treatment_plan: Rotate the password and move it to the secrets service; restrict to 2 administrators; hash and control-total check before upload

threat_event: The plan TPA or PBM suffers a breach of plan PHI and notifies the plan late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BAAs (2024) allow 60 days for breach notice; TPA SOC 2 not yet reviewed
existing_controls: BAAs on file
treatment_plan: Shorter notice terms at renewal; annual SOC 2 review of the TPA (P09)

threat_event: Subsidiaries buy or turn on technology (AI recruiting, the voice agent, new SaaS) outside group review, creating unmanaged risk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Subsidiary Presidents had no written cyber duties; procurement review bypassed
existing_controls: Group procurement for IT purchases over $25,000
treatment_plan: Written cyber duties for Presidents; monthly cyber risk forum; purchasing gate for any software or AI feature
